prompt:
You are improving category descriptions for a bank customer-message classifier.

The classifier is a decision model. It picks one category for each customer message by
reading the category descriptions. It reads them literally and knows nothing beyond what
is written in them. Right now each description is just the category name with spaces.

Below are the category pairs it confuses most often on a tuning set, with real messages it
got wrong. Write a new description for EVERY category listed under "Categories to rewrite".

Rules:
- One or two sentences each, in plain English.
- Say what the customer's message is about, and what separates this category from the one
  it gets confused with. Name the other category if that helps ("...not X, which is ...").
- Describe the intent in general terms. Do not quote or closely copy the example messages.
- Keep each description true for its whole category, not just these examples.

Reply with a JSON object only: {"<category name>": "<new description>", ...} using the
exact category names below.

Categories to rewrite (current description in brackets):
- beneficiary_not_allowed [beneficiary not allowed]
- card_arrival [card arrival]
- card_delivery_estimate [card delivery estimate]
- card_not_working [card not working]
- card_payment_not_recognised [card payment not recognised]
- card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate [card payment wrong exchange rate]
- change_pin [change pin]
- declined_card_payment [declined card payment]
- declined_transfer [declined transfer]
- direct_debit_payment_not_recognised [direct debit payment not recognised]
- exchange_rate [exchange rate]
- get_physical_card [get physical card]
- order_physical_card [order physical card]
- verify_my_identity [verify my identity]
- why_verify_identity [why verify identity]

Confused pairs, with messages the classifier got wrong:

card_arrival <> card_delivery_estimate  (5 mistakes)
  - "Can I track my card while it is in the process of delivery?"  correct: card_arrival, classifier said: card_delivery_estimate
  - "What is the expected delivery date for my card?"  correct: card_arrival, classifier said: card_delivery_estimate
  - "Can I get an update on my replacement card?"  correct: card_arrival, classifier said: card_delivery_estimate

card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate <> exchange_rate  (5 mistakes)
  - "What if there is an error on the exchange rate?"  correct: card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate, classifier said: exchange_rate
  - "It seems that the rate I got is incorrect."  correct: card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate, classifier said: exchange_rate
  - "My client was converting their Russian ruble into UK pound currency when they noticed their bill was much too high for the exchange. What happened?"  correct: card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate, classifier said: exchange_rate

verify_my_identity <> why_verify_identity  (4 mistakes)
  - "It's requiring me to verify my identity?"  correct: why_verify_identity, classifier said: verify_my_identity
  - "How does identity check work?"  correct: why_verify_identity, classifier said: verify_my_identity
  - "how do I speed up identity verification?"  correct: why_verify_identity, classifier said: verify_my_identity

change_pin <> get_physical_card  (4 mistakes)
  - "i have yet to get my pin"  correct: get_physical_card, classifier said: change_pin
  - "I didn't get a PIN yet. What gives?"  correct: get_physical_card, classifier said: change_pin
  - "When will I have access to my pin number?"  correct: get_physical_card, classifier said: change_pin

get_physical_card <> order_physical_card  (4 mistakes)
  - "Is a physical card also available"  correct: order_physical_card, classifier said: get_physical_card
  - "Can I get an actual card"  correct: order_physical_card, classifier said: get_physical_card
  - "I would really like a physical card."  correct: order_physical_card, classifier said: get_physical_card

card_payment_not_recognised <> direct_debit_payment_not_recognised  (3 mistakes)
  - "I saw money was taken out of my account by a seller a while back. I do not recognize the seller, but I'm pretty certain I didn't make that payment. Can you track who the seller is?"  correct: direct_debit_payment_not_recognised, classifier said: card_payment_not_recognised
  - "Purchases I did not make are appearing in my bank statement?"  correct: direct_debit_payment_not_recognised, classifier said: card_payment_not_recognised
  - "I checked my account and see that funds were deducted from a seller I didn't approve of. Can you help me understand?"  correct: direct_debit_payment_not_recognised, classifier said: card_payment_not_recognised

card_not_working <> declined_card_payment  (3 mistakes)
  - "I'm not sure why my card didn't work"  correct: declined_card_payment, classifier said: card_not_working
  - "My card is not working at stores."  correct: declined_card_payment, classifier said: card_not_working
  - "I could not get my card to work at a shop."  correct: declined_card_payment, classifier said: card_not_working

beneficiary_not_allowed <> declined_transfer  (3 mistakes)
  - "I tried to transfer funds to a beneficiary and was denied. Can you tell me why?"  correct: beneficiary_not_allowed, classifier said: declined_transfer
  - "A transfer was not allowed to an account."  correct: beneficiary_not_allowed, classifier said: declined_transfer
  - "Why am I unable to transfer money when I was able to before?"  correct: beneficiary_not_allowed, classifier said: declined_transfer

drafts.beneficiary_not_allowed: Use this when a customer is asking why a specific person or account they tried to send money to was rejected or blocked as a payee. This differs from declined_transfer, which covers transfers that failed for reasons unrelated to the recipient, such as insufficient funds or system errors.
drafts.card_arrival: Use this when a customer wants to know if or where their ordered or replacement card currently is, including tracking its status or confirming it has arrived. This differs from card_delivery_estimate, which is about general shipping time expectations rather than the status of a specific card.
drafts.card_delivery_estimate: Use this when a customer is asking how long card delivery typically takes in general, before or without referencing a specific order's current status. This differs from card_arrival, which is about tracking or checking on a particular card that has already been ordered.
drafts.card_not_working: Use this when a customer reports that their card itself is malfunctioning in general, such as not being read, chipped, or broken, rather than describing one specific purchase that failed. This differs from declined_card_payment, which is about a single transaction being rejected.
drafts.card_payment_not_recognised: Use this when a customer does not recognize a charge made using their card for a purchase. This differs from direct_debit_payment_not_recognised, which covers automatic or recurring payments taken directly from the account rather than a card purchase.
drafts.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: Use this when a customer believes the currency conversion rate applied to a specific card purchase abroad was incorrect or resulted in an unexpectedly high charge. This differs from exchange_rate, which covers general questions about current rates or how conversion works, not tied to a particular transaction.
drafts.change_pin: Use this when a customer who already has a PIN wants to update, reset, or change it. This differs from get_physical_card, which covers situations where the customer has not yet received their PIN or card at all.
drafts.declined_card_payment: Use this when a customer describes a specific attempted card purchase that was rejected or did not go through. This differs from card_not_working, which is about the card malfunctioning in general rather than one failed transaction.
drafts.declined_transfer: Use this when a customer's money transfer failed for reasons unrelated to the recipient being blocked, such as technical issues, limits, or insufficient funds. This differs from beneficiary_not_allowed, which is specifically about a particular payee or account being rejected.
drafts.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: Use this when a customer notices an automatic or recurring payment taken from their account that they don't recognize or didn't authorize, without it being a direct card purchase. This differs from card_payment_not_recognised, which is about unrecognized card transactions.
drafts.exchange_rate: Use this when a customer is asking a general question about current currency exchange rates or how they are determined, not about a specific transaction. This differs from card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate, which is about a rate applied incorrectly to a particular card purchase.
drafts.get_physical_card: Use this when a customer is asking about receiving or the status of a physical card or its PIN that has already been requested. This differs from order_physical_card, which is about requesting a physical card for the first time.
drafts.order_physical_card: Use this when a customer wants to request or find out if they can obtain a physical card, typically when they currently only have a virtual one. This differs from get_physical_card, which is about the delivery status of a card already ordered.
drafts.verify_my_identity: Use this when a customer is asking how to complete the identity verification process, such as what steps or documents are needed. This differs from why_verify_identity, which is about understanding the reason verification is required.
drafts.why_verify_identity: Use this when a customer is asking why identity verification is required or how the process works in general, rather than trying to actually complete it. This differs from verify_my_identity, which covers requests to perform or finish the verification steps.
